# ensemble-analyze-requirements

> **Mission:** Run `node "$TRD_CLI" analyze <trd-path> --prd <prd-path>`, interpret the JSON, and add a PRD-vs-TRD contradiction scan. Task ids are checkbox lines `- [ ] **TRD-NNN**: Title` under `## Master Task List` (not headings); PRD ids are `### REQ-NNN:` and `- AC-NNN-M:`.

> **Constraints:**
> - DO NOT implement or execute any work described in the documents
> - Read-only and advisory (not a CI gate)
> - Statistics come from `trd-cli analyze`; only the contradiction scan is your judgement

## Phase 1: Analyze

### Step 1: Run the CLI

Require PRD then TRD path, both existing; else print the error and exit 1.
Resolve TRD_CLI per the tool-path-resolution skill, run `node "$TRD_CLI" analyze "<trd>" --prd "<prd>"`;
on `{"error":...}` print it and exit 1.

### Step 2: Contradiction scan

Read both documents for conflicts on one feature (sync vs async, differing limits, auth, SLAs); cite PRD and TRD lines.

### Step 3: Report

Print `verdict` (count contradictions as warnings: errors -> NOT READY, >5 -> CAUTION, >0 -> MOSTLY READY, else READY),
`phases`, `dependencies`, `estimates.missing`, `traceability`, `prdWarnings`, and `validation` findings,
each with a one-line remediation.
